columns.name: PROM_ELIGIBILTY_ID
columns.description: Unique row id of promotion eligibility

columns.name: PROM_ELIGIBILTY_NAME
columns.description: indicates name of promotion eligibility rule

columns.name: PROM_ELIGIBILTY_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: indicates description of promotion eligibility rule

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: indicates flag indicating if the rule is active or not

columns.name: CONDITION_PARAMETER
columns.description: indicates the parameter (factor) of the criteria

columns.name: CONDITION_VALUE
columns.description: indicates the value is filled for the comparison of the criteria

columns.name: PROMOTION_TYPE
columns.description: indicates the type of promotion eligibility rule allowed

columns.name: CONDITION_OP_CODE
columns.description: indicates the logic expression including parameter and operator

columns.name: PROD_OFFER_ID
columns.description: indicates the unique identifier of product offer

columns.name: START_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Start time from which the promotion pattern is valid

columns.name: END_DATE_TIME
columns.description: End Time to which the promotion  pattern is valid

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
